guides.favoredWhen: She must all-in your low-mana Rs early before you outscale. Hold Q, stack Rs, punish.

keyTips.text: She never trades into your post-Q shield: the bubble wins exchanges, so hold it.
Your Electrocute burst matches hers: take the trade when shielded.
You outscale: the clock runs for you.

tips.text: She all-ins when you R in low on stacks or mana: never jump empty early.
She pokes the shield downtime: Q-shield gaps are her damage gaps, so vary.
She forces before stacks: each R stacks the timer for you.
She punishes low-mana jumps: manage mana, never jump dry.
Early survived plus scaled: the Akali who never converted never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: She bullies from level 1 and one Charm ruins your lane. Take sustain, survive, outscale.

keyTips.text: She baits your Q before trading (about {cd:38:Q}): vary the timing.
She harasses every walk-up: concede CS to stay healthy.
After 6 she never settles for even farming: match her roams or punish the crash.

tips.text: She bullies hard from 1 with burst and Charm: take DShield plus sustain if unsure.
She punishes every walk-up: give CS, keep XP.
She keeps pushing and roaming: you lack waveclear, so catch waves and scale.
She holds Charm for your jumps: bait it before committing.
She cashes the lead before you outscale: survive and you beat her late.
Even lanes beat her: survive lane, win game.

guides.favoredWhen: She crushes early with Comet and the lead is the lane. Survive, scale, answer TP.

keyTips.text: She crushes early, you take over later: the clock runs for you.
She builds a big early lead with Comet and Teleport, so respect her early pressure.
She punishes every walkup: your melee range is her Q range, so concede.

tips.text: Comet poke from level 1: survive the stack before you function.
She TPs back with an item: the second buy buries you, so crash before it.
You get harder with levels: play for your spikes landing.
She TPs while you are stuck: hold wave, never base into it.
Scale reached plus items done: the Syndra whose lead never converted never wins.

keyTips.text: Farm safely to level 6 and refuse repeated pre-R trades that park Kassadin too close to opponents.
After the first item, shove waves when safe and hunt kill chances in other lanes.
At level 16, spend the third R rank on repeated picks and backline access.

tips.text: Ward early because weak-lane Kassadin invites camps and farm denial.
Use unlocked R both to trade and to disengage when exchanges turn bad.
Farm gold and experience over forcing low-value fights.
Take only favoring fights; with grouped enemies and a bad approach, return to farming.
When the ADC and support rotate mid, farm side waves for free resources without contesting center.
At level 11, burst harder with the second R rank and its more frequent access.
At level 9, answer ganks and all-ins better with the first maxed ability and its higher damage.
Flank mispositioned targets for the burst, then R out before the collapse lands.
Turn each pick into a push or objective instead of chasing further.
Group with a team that wins grouped fights; otherwise pull opponents sidelane while allies press objectives elsewhere.

itemization.text: Reach first-item and later spikes through safe farming.
